name: Queen & Knight
source:
A fairytale styled yuri about a Queen and her Knight and what happens when they say they love each other.

[From [url=https://atelierbubbletea.itch.io/queen-and-knight]Itch.io[/url]]

一个童话风格的百合故事，讲的是一位女王与她的骑士，还有当她们对彼此说出“我爱你”之后，会发生什么。
